messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Acacia renewal. They verbally agreed to list price but procurement is pushing for a 9‑month term and net45 payment. PO is stuck due to vendor code mismatch and VAT fields for EU billing. Can revops + legal advise on acceptable term/pricing adjustments? cc @jason_revops @oliver_legal

jason_revops: I pulled the draft PO. Finance says we can accept a 9mo commitment if we do a prorated charge (no backward pricing change). Need a firm formula and finance approval. Also: what's their signatory flow? Is e-sign ok? :eyes:

oliver_legal: Prefer an amendment instead of modifying the original contract text. We can add a 1‑paragraph addendum stating: term = 9 months, payment = prorated from annual list, invoice will include VAT ID. Need exact legal entity name and signatory. E‑sign via Docusign is fine for DE entities.

devin_procurement: Procurement flagged vendor code mismatch: PO uses `ACQ-RED-OLD-2024` but our vendor code is `ACQ-REDWOOD-2026`. That causes automated rejection in their system. Also requesting billing contact on invoice and VAT ID. They asked whether we can accept PO with the old code if they include a note; finance prefers code corrected.

jason_revops: Finance approved the prorate approach. Proposed calc: `ProratedAmount = round((ListPrice / 12) * TermMonths, 2)` Example we gave to them: `ListPrice = 24,000 EUR/year -> Monthly = 2,000 EUR -> 9mo = 18,000 EUR`. We'll include rounding to nearest euro on final invoice.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll confirm the calc with Lena (customer contact) and push procurement to update the vendor code. Also confirm signer: Lena Müller (Head of Procurement) will route. She prefers local Docusign.

oliver_legal: I'll draft the amendment now. Will include: 1) term change to 9 months, 2) prorate formula (copy the formula above), 3) billing entity and VAT clause, 4) signature block for "Authorized Signatory". I recommend we include an explicit acceptance clause: "This Amendment is effective upon signature by both parties."

finance_bot: Finance note: once PO with correct vendor code is received, we can book the invoice as net45. Please upload PO to Finance portal with annotation: `Acacia — 9mo amendment — prorated invoice` to expedite.

maria_cs: Action items: maria -> ask Acacia to update vendor code and confirm VAT ID; jason -> confirm final invoice rounding with finance; oliver -> drop amendment and Docusign envelope; devin -> confirm procurement will accept amended PO. ETA: end of day tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Update 20min later — procurement replied, they will issue corrected PO. They attached a small PO snippet (redacted):
```
PO#: 980-AC-2026
VendorCode: ACQ-REDWOOD-2026
BillTo: Acacia GmbH, VAT DE123456789
TermMonths: 9
Payment: Net45
```

jason_revops: Perfect. Finance confirmed rounding and net45 acceptable. Once we have the signed amendment + PO we can finalize invoicing.

oliver_legal: Amendment uploaded to Legal Drive and Docusign envelope created. Sending to maria to confirm signer email for envelope routing.

maria_cs: Sent Lena the Docusign invite and the prorate calc. Will update here when signed. Thanks everyone.
